########################################################################
# Include python install macros
########################################################################
include(GrPython)
if(NOT PYTHONINTERP_FOUND)
    return()
endif()


########################################################################
# Install python sources
########################################################################
gr_python_install(FILES __init__.py
    controller.py
    dial_probe.py
    msg_setter.py
    dial_from_tag.py
    dial_adapter.py
    capture_dial.py
    _pmt.py
    dashboard.py DESTINATION ${GR_PYTHON_DIR}/gnuradio/rxtune)

########################################################################
# Handle the unit tests
########################################################################
# The blocks are thin wrappers: the pure-Python core ships with them.
install(DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/rxtune DESTINATION ${GR_PYTHON_DIR}
        FILES_MATCHING PATTERN "*.py" PATTERN "*.yaml" PATTERN "__pycache__" EXCLUDE)

include(GrTest)


# Create a package directory that tests can import. It includes everything
# from `python/`.
add_custom_target(
    copy_module_for_tests ALL
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
            ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/test_modules/gnuradio/rxtune/)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_controller ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_controller.py)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_dial_probe ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_dial_probe.py)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_msg_setter ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_msg_setter.py)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_dial_from_tag ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_dial_from_tag.py)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_dial_adapter ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_dial_adapter.py)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_loopback ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_loopback.py)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_dashboard ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_dashboard.py)
